author: Michael Larabel
description: The newest Wayland compositor on the block is Nourish, it's a Vulkan-powered and its unique selling point is offering "infinite" zooming and panning to in effect provide an infinite workspace...
title: Nourish: A New Wayland Compositor Powered By Vulkan With Infinite Scrolling/Panning

author: Michael Larabel
description: Linux kernel developer and Bytedance engineer Qi Zheng sent out a request for comments (RFC) patch series on a new feature called Reserved THP to combine the best of HugeTLB and THP kernel functionality...
title: Reserved THP Feature Proposed For Linux To Combine The Best Of HugeTLB & THP

author: Michael Larabel
description: Posted to the Linux kernel mailing list this week was a new patch series working on scalability enhancements to the MD RAID5 software RAID code. Up to a 10~17% improvement was observed in some configurations with these RAID5 scalability patches...
title: Linux MD RAID5 Seeing Scalability Improvements Up To 17%

author: Michael Larabel
description: In development over the past three years has been Newelle as a GNOME-aligned AI virtual assistant. Out this week is Newelle 1.4.5 and it now adds AI image generation support and a redesigned chat interface...
title: GNOME AI Assistant Adds Image Generation Support

author: Michael Larabel
description: While Plasma 6.7.1 was just released this week following the recent stable debut of Plasma 6.7, there are already a number of fixes piling up for Plasma 6.7.2 due out in July. Plus more feature work and fixes for Plasma 6.8 as the next desktop version going Wayland-only...
title: KDE Plasma 6.7.2 To Fix KWin's Most Common Crash, Plasma 6.8 To Not Crash When Ejecting CDs
